requirements.text: Students should have a user-friendly interface to customize their timetable, including options for color-coding modules, hiding canceled classes, and adding personal study blocks without affecting system performance.

Students should receive timely notifications for new grades, upcoming assignment deadlines, and exam reminders, with options for delivery via email, in-app alerts, or push notifications, ensuring flexibility without adding complexity.

Students should be able to provide feedback on module content quality, delivery, and resources via a straightforward and anonymous process after the teaching period, without disrupting grading or existing workflows.
Any enhancements to the portal should not disrupt the current system's performance or create extra maintenance work.
The feedback process should be straightforward and encourage participation without complicating existing workflows.
